hotels.title: Stylish Chatswood Escape near Westfield Shopping Precinct & Train Station
hotels.description: Discover a stylish urban oasis perfectly positioned in Sydney's northeastern suburbs, just a 20-minute train ride from Sydney's glittering harbour, iconic landmarks and vibrant CBD. Sitting steps from Westfield Chatswood, with over 250 stores (including major retailers and a cinema complex), this hotel boasts seamless access to Chatswood Transport Interchange while being just moments away from world-class boutiques and restaurants. The hotel offers fabulous facilities, including a shimmering indoor heated pool, a modern onsite restaurant and a fully equipped fitness centre. For a well-deserved beverage after hours of shopping up a storm, the terrace beckons with uninterrupted vistas that stretch far into the horizon.
